title: Requests and limits: what happens when CPU or memory runs out

videos.script: A container asks for resources in two numbers, and they answer different questions. {{two}} The request is a reservation. The scheduler adds up requests, and places a pod only where its request still fits. Nothing measures what the pod really uses. {{request}} The limit is a ceiling, enforced on the node while the pod runs. {{limit}} And the two resources behave differently at the ceiling. A container over its CPU limit is slowed down. A container over its memory limit is killed. {{differ}} You will fill two nodes until a pod has nowhere to go, slow one copy of the shop to a tenth of its speed, and watch another one die for taking thirty megabytes too many. {{plan}}
